reviews.text: I love this place.  I almost don't want to tell too many people in fear it will get too busy or hard to book.  They are amazing and I finally dont feel guilty when I use it for daycare and boarding.

Hi Alicia, 
Thank you for leaving us a 5-star review! Our team loved getting to host Hamilton and Honey and hope to see them again soon.

I left to go out of the country for nine days, one of my biggest anxieties about going on vacation was what to do with my dogs. One of my dogs is reactive, the other one has had issues in the past with being boarded in a kennel.  Let me tell you…this place is amazing. The daily pictures and daily updates on how they were doing put my mind at ease and took a big stress reliever off of me while on vacation. They took amazing care of my two boys.   Cannot thank them enough for how outstanding they are.
Absolutely incredible service here! Cant speaking highly enough of the workers there and their genuine care for my dog!
Great service from the staff. Highly recommend. Maggie stayed with them for two weeks.
My dog loves to go to Yardstick! The staff is wonderful!
Our dog Rigby had a great four nights at the Lakewood Yardstick!  They even sent pictures of him with his new friends!   Highly recommend!
The very best , most excellent boarding facility I’ve ever been to. They are so caring! They send pictures all day to the owners . I give this place 100 stars !!

Yardstick is our local go-to doggie daycare.  Both of our dogs will board there soon and our daughter's 3 dogs board there often.  That should tell you how confident we are that the pups are well cared for!  Great place!!
Ringo is all smiles at his new daycare!
I can tell they take really good care of my dog and cares about his wellbeing. This is his 2nd time and nothing but a good experience. He was excited at drop off and pick up :)

We used this facility for the first time for a 2week boarding period.  Visited this site and several other boarding places and there was a day and night difference in YardSticks facility and care plan!!
Thus it was a successful and safe place for our dog to board.  We received updates and pictures throughout the day on his journey.  And feedback was very responsive in answering questions during our dogs stay!!

Yardstick did a fabulous job with my fur baby. They took such great care of her and send a lot of picture updates so you feel comfortable they are in great hands. The facility was very nice and clean.

Ive boarded my 2 year old Bernese mountain dog named Crouton here several times. Ranging from 2 nights to 6. My biggest worry is always him over heating or his loose poops from separation anxiety. Yardstick has always been great. Im always confident theyll be friendly and professional with him. They send you multiple pictures and updates throughout the day and are just super responsive.

No complaints. Will continue to board there. Wouldnt mind them adding a loyalty program.. just saying.

Another great stay at Yardstick Lakewood. It’s our go to whenever we need a place for our dog. The staff is friendly and is excited about our dog. He seems to enjoy the other dogs he gets to hang with during the day and the pics and communication throughout the stay are great. We will be back, actually in less than a week because we have another trip planned.
Great staff and very friendly.
Very nice and professional.  My dogs love going!
Buddy enjoyed his stay. He was more comfortable and happier,  not stressed.  Facility very clean and staff attentive to dogs.
Love, love, love Yardstick!!!  Great team!  Made our puppy’s 1st birthday very special!!

Our rescue has the biggest heart, and we wanted to be mindful of where we brought him to play and board. We loveeee how communicative the staff is, and everyone has made an effort for our pup to feel loved and safe. It’s such a calm place, and we love all of the pics we get while we are apart.
Such a great place!  My dog loved it!  People are so friendly and genuinely seemed to care about each dog.

Yardstick to excellent care of our three (3) fur babies while we were out of town. The staff is very caring, they sent me photos every day of my dogs and made sure they were all happy. I highly recommend Yardstick for dog boarding!
Another great stay for our pup. They kept him happy and well cared for. They updated us with photos throughout his stay.

Clean facility, great staff, matched my pup to compatible dogs for supervised play.
Same excellent care and service during a one week boarding as during day care. Our pup loves it here!  I highly recommend Yardstick Lakewood.

I was gobsmacked by the pricing, but my fur baby girl Pia had a delightful stay!  Like doggy camp!  I toured the facility before her stay and was super impressed by the cleanliness and lack of stink, including the potty area. They showed me the little room cells (not crates!) where she’d sleep. They sent me tons of text photos all day with notes on her progress, every day. I got to see her making friends in play group, and I swear she was smiling!  Upon checking out, the gal at the front desk was saying that she loved my Pia and spent a lot of time with her one on one. I might have thought that they say that to everyone, but Pia’s little head smelled like another woman’s cologne, so I know someone was nuzzling my baby!!

Another huge perk is that they let you bring your own toys and doggy bed if you want. I talked to a lot of boarding places and personal items are typically NOT allowed.  I love that Pia had the smells of home in her room for comfort.

The last time I boarded Pia elsewhere, I was sold on her staying in a “doggy suite” which turned out to be a crate. I was horrified that she’d been crated for a week without my knowing!  Now I take a tour first, to see with my own eyes.  I walked in wo notice and requested a tour, so no chance to tidy up beforehand. Very clean!

Yes, her boarding fee here was equivalent to a nice hotel stay, but I got photos and notes and did not worry about her. The pictures kept coming and she was clean and happy. I will pay for that!

Yardstick Lakewood team is fantastic! Always friendly, very accommodating, experienced and kind! My 2 dogs had their first stay this weekend and they sent me updates via pictures and messages that I truly appreciated! My babies came home happy and that makes me very happy! Thank you, Henry O. and your amazing staff for being AWESOME!!!

My fuzzy kids were so happy and they were there for almost 2 weeks. Every single one of the staff loved my Bonnie and Clyde and my dogs loved them! This is my first need for boarding and this is the only place I'll ever need.

OUTSTANDING service and care/love, AND the great photos I got every day at every stage of their stay

THIS is the place you're looking for!!
🐾🐾❤️❤️🐾🐾☮️
The second we entered, Shot was very excited and happy to be at Yardstick. Proof positive she has such a positive experience while being there.
Hi Patti, thank you for leaving us a 5-star review. We can't wait to host Kaiser with us again soon!
Our pups love Yardstick! We do too. Great staff they send us lots of picture and updates. We have peace of mind when we board our girls. I highly recommend you try them out 👏🏻

We’ve had a fantastic experience with Yardstick. They thoughtfully separate dogs by size and energy level, so playtime is always safe and a great fit—and the multiple play sessions each day keep my dog happy and well-exercised.
I also love the frequent photo updates—it gives me total peace of mind while I’m away. Most importantly, the staff truly treat my dog like their own. She’s always excited to go back, which says everything. Highly recommend!

Wonderful first time experience - would recommend! The facilities are extremely clean, surprisingly smells like a 5-star hotel in Hawaii, and the staff is very nice. Also the texts/pictures are really nice to get and fun while you're away!
First time to leave the pup while we were overseas. Very appreciative of the regular updates and photos - gave us peace of mind.
Great 1st experience with boarding! Our dog was taken care of and shown great attention and care.

The staff went above and beyond to make my pup, Captain, feel at home! My dog can be awkward and shy in unfamiliar spaces. They did a great job helping him feel welcome. I can tell by his demeanor after picking him up that he actually had a good time! And I added on a bath before pickup and he smells amazing 🥰  even during the tour walkthrough I can tell they keep the place very clean and the dogs calm and happy!

I am impressed with YardStick-Lakewood. The staff are friendly and really care about the dogs. The entrance, boarding and play areas are very clean, spacious and modern. I like receiving texts with pictures of my dog playing and hanging out with other dogs. I also like that they keep the groups small for play time.
Always a positive experience! The staff are kind and caring to me and my pup! They go above and beyond expectations. Buzz and I are very happy with Yardstick Lakewood!!!

I was very pleased with my Pet's first Visit.  She is a Senior Dachshund - I spoil her very much and so did the Caretakers at Lakewood Yardstick!  I Loved getting photos throughout the day!
Everyone was so friendly to me and my pet.

I have already booked for her to stay there the next time I go out of town or even need a Single Day Stay...

I would be pleased to recommend Yardstick to everyone I know.
Rhonda

Hi Kendall,

Thank you for leaving us a 5-star review!

This place is absolutely wonderful, from the moment you enter the lobby all the way to the back were they have the suites and play areas. It's clean (in fact, upon entry all you smell is a wonderful aroma (don't know what it is, but it smells very pleasant and clean). The staff is very courteous, attentive. They send status pictures and messages throughout the day from morning to evening sleep time. My dog has been happy every time, and looks forward to the stay the times I've taken him. I've recommended it to several people in my neighborhood and close vicinity neighborhoods.

We really love this place and our dog does too! The staff was very genuine and caring and we received multiple updates and photos throughout the day. Extremely clean environment and our dog seemed almost reluctant to leave when we picked her up! Very few things are as important to us as our dog, but I thoroughly trust Yardstick with the care and love for our pet and we will definitely be using them going forward. Highly recommend!!
The staff is very attentive and my dogs love staying at Yardstick!  I looked forward to all of the daily pics and it put my mind at ease to see how they were doing.

First time ever boarding my dog in my life and I chose this place because I’ve heard great things. Well I’m very upset now because my flight landed later than expected, causing me to be about 10 minutes late for pick up and they charge you if your late. I wish they would understand I can’t control my flight and now this makes me even more anxious to board my dog again. Will not be returning or recommending to anyone.

Went on vacation and i was kinda
Nervous cause my puppy rarley been away from home or around alot of dogs.
So i got updates everyday while i was away they said he did good and he made a friend name Macaroni. Im so glad we found this place and they do daycare as well.  We will be back might have to just put him in daycare. And they did his nails so happy for that. Thank yall great place.

We appreciate yall from Chef Gio and Rozay😎😎😎
Thank you for your review! We truly appreciate your feedback and look forward to having Wrigley back with us. Give him some love from us!
Ellie and Penny love their stays at Yardstick! We always know they are well taken care of with lots of play, snacks, and love!
The yardstick team is responsive, caring, and accommodating! Our dog is so well cared for there!

The Yardstick team was amazing at sending updates on my dog's status during his week of boarding.  We received text messages and pictures a few times a day that put our minds at ease, and the team was very easy to reach and coordinate with.  We will be back!

I couldn't be more happier with my dogs play stay at Yardstick Lakewood location. I was greeted by smiling faces and eager to help get my dogs checked in and assuring me that they would be well taken care of. My day was filled with tons of pictures of them playing with other dogs and how happy they were.  Thank you Henry especially for being so sweet and giving them their mani-peds and returning them oh so clean with their cute bandannas. We will be back!! 🐶🐾🐶🐾♥️
Staff very involved with my dog on her first play day.   Kept me informed and took pictures to email.   I was very comfortable booking overnight stays for her

This place is a gem! From the first step inside, it smells amazing and that's a good sign for a dog hotel. The private rooms are great for anxious dogs and we loved the way they handled play time by putting our dog with dogs that had a similar energy to her but also were a similar size to her. Mostly we loved all of the pictures we got of our sweet puppy while she was there!

The staff at Yardstick are so kind and really care for your dog. We always get great photos during her stay and she comes back so happy. Thanks especially to Henry for taking care of our 4 legged child.
Thank you Emily for your 5 star review! We hope you enjoyed our services just as much as Kevin, he had tons of fun and instantly made friends. We look forward to continue hosting sweet Kevin!
Baxter loves yardstick!
They sent tons of pictures during the stay!
The employees at yardstick are kind and helpful every time I bring my dog, Winston, here for daycare! Winston always leaves feeling loved, and enjoys his play times.

All of the staff is so great with our dogs. The facility is super clean and smells wonderful when you walk in. They send pictures throughout the day and we couldn’t ask for better treatment of our dogs.

Like every pawrent out there, we felt anxious boarding our shy Sofie for more than a week with strangers. Our expectations were not only met but went beyond what we could imagine. The staff at Yardstick go the extra mile because they truly regard each pup in their care as their own with specific needs.  She went from hiding in a corner to playing hard with new friends in just two days. When I picked her up, she was more confident in herself and absolutely glowing! Yardstick is like Montessori school for dogs!

Besides having a clean and well-maintained facility, they communicate consistently each day via picture/text message updates. We have used other doggy daycares before in the dallas area which were simply satisfactory. With Yardstick, you not only gain a peace of mind but you will also get an extended family for your doggo. Yardstick set the new standard for excellence!

**Shoutout to all the wonderful and compassionate staff at Yardstick! (to name a few: Jess, John and T)

We had an amazing experience with this dog boarding service. They truly went above and beyond to meet my dog’s individual needs and made sure they were comfortable, happy, and well cared for. They sent pictures daily and share contact info. to text them at anytime. I had total peace of mind knowing my dogs were in such caring hands.

Yardstick in Lakewood was absolutely wonderful. We had to go out of town for days and they sent so many pictures and updates on how our dog was doing, which really put our minds at ease and we were able to enjoy our vacation.

I can't say enough good things about the team and the facility at Yardstick!
I have a very challenging boxer boy who I employed a dog nanny to take care of while I travel up until mid last year.
Dog nanny had to quit and I was left with a challenge because he had never been boarded. I tried to find sitters on Rover and other apps but I did not feel comfortable with any of the folks I met.
I happened to be at Target and noticed Yardstick was new. I called, scheduled the meet & greet and I am so glad I did! The Team is fantastic with my boy! He goes for daycare and for boarding. They stay in constant contact with photos and respond so quickly!

They took really great care of my dog. I love the frequent updates and photos of how he is doing. When we dropped him off, he knew exactly where we are and got super excited to go play with his friends. 100% recommend.

Would highly recommend for dog boarding. I was initially nervous leaving my baby. However the facility was clean, the staff was amazing and I received constant updates on my dog and what was going on. They listened to all the instructions I left!

Great experience! The employees were very kind and attentive to our dog. We especially appreciated the pictures sent throughout her stay. This was our first time at Yardstick and we were very pleased.
They were fantastic and sent pictures all day! Wonderful staff and care! They even noticed he wasn’t eating and provided solutions. They were wonderful!

Our dog Fiji stayed at the Yardstick Lakewood location for 6 days while we were out of town for Christmas, and we had a great experience! We loved receiving daily photo updates—it gave us so much peace of mind. When we picked her up, she was happy and clearly well cared for. We will definitely continue using Yardstick for their boarding services. I Highly recommend using them!

We had an amazing experience with Yardstick! Our dogs, Spiro and Dakota, absolutely loved their week there, and it gave us so much peace of mind while we were away. The constant photo updates were incredible—we loved seeing how happy and relaxed they were. We also really appreciated that it wasn’t packed with dogs; it truly felt like our pups got individualized attention, lots of love, and great care. We wouldn’t hesitate to board them here again and highly recommend Yardstick to anyone looking for a place that treats your dogs like family.

We were very reluctant to board our dog because she hadn’t boarded in years, she’s elderly and blind, and Yardstick did an amazing job with her. I highly recommend them for any type of dog and we will be coming back!

Yardstick is simply the best. Our two dogs have a difficult time being boarded but not at Yardstick! They are so loved and cared for at Yardstick that they happily run in each time. I love getting photos texted to me throughout our stay. Jess was awesome when we had to make a last minute reservation this holiday season.

I cannot say enough good things about Yardstick Doggie Daycare and Boarding. They are truly exceptional.  What sets them apart immediately is that they are breed inclusive and thoughtfully group dogs by play style rather than just size, which creates a safer, happier environment for every dog.

The playgroups are intentionally kept small, which gives me great peace of mind knowing my dogs are being closely supervised and cared for. The staff is extremely friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely loves what they do—you can feel it the moment you walk in the door. Shout out to Jess!

I also really appreciate how well they keep you updated throughout the day with photos. It’s such a comfort to see your dog happy, engaged, and well cared for while you’re away.

For boarding, the fact that someone stays overnight is huge. That level of care and attention is rare and makes all the difference. Yardstick has completely earned my trust for both daycare and boarding, and I would recommend them without hesitation to anyone looking for a safe, professional, and loving environment for their dog. Extra bonus they support rescue dogs!

We had a great experience with Yardstick! Gess was absolutely awesome with our dog Max, who usually gets anxious and doesn’t like being boarded. He loved her and had a great time, which gave us so much peace of mind. Highly recommend!

Our girl had the best time! We loved seeing pictures of her throughout her stay. Henry gave us a great tour, and the place is immaculate. They clearly care about the dogs as if they are their own. Highly recommend!
They have been amazing! Super accommodating and my dog seems super happy. Henry was super helpful and gave us the whole run down.
We absolutely love Yardstick! My dog loves the staff and always is excited to go back. The staff is very kind and helpful. I love the picture updates they send as well!

We did a trial day for our 2 dachshunds before they go back for a week of boarding. This was their first experience at any kind of daycare or kennel, and it was great! Henry gave me a tour on the spot when I came in. Everything is clean and smells good. My dogs were anxious when I left them, but they warmed up to the staff quickly and looked happy in the picture updates. When I picked my pups up, they weren’t acting weird at all and didn’t have any unpleasant odors. I feel very comfortable leaving them to board for a week!

Yardstick Lakewood took great care of our dogs while we were on vacation. Many thanks to the staff for always sending lots of pics and keeping us updated. We will be back for daycare and boarding when we need it. Highly recommend Yardstick!

Love bringing my dog here for daycare! They make it so easy to drop off for a quick day of daycare for him to burn some energy. I love that they send photos throughout the day too!! Henry helped me out today & he was great. :)

This daycare is fantastic! The team is wonderful with Banjo, always playing with him and sending us sweet photo updates of his day. He literally pulls toward the door when we arrive. Highly recommend!
My dog enjoys herself and her pup cups on each stay! All the staff is friendly, flexible and helpful.

Yardstick Lakewood is absolutely amazing! The entire staff is incredibly friendly, patient, and caring (special shoutout to Mia, John, and Henry😊). They always greet my dog by name the moment we walk in, know his little quirks, and keep me updated throughout the day with pictures.

It’s clear they pay attention and truly love what they do. They remember if he finished his breakfast, how he played, and who his favorite buddies were that day. I’d be offended by how excited he is to go inside in the mornings, except that it gives me such peace of mind knowing he’s happy and taken care of.

Thank you Yardstick for taking such good care of Toby, we couldn’t be happier!
A very positive experience.
Knox LOVES his stays at Yardstick! And I never have to worry about how he’s doing because they send me a camera roll of photos everyday :) !!! We love this place so much.

Great experience boarding my mixed breed large dog! Mia listened carefully to all instructions and Henry was very helpful. I received lots of picture updates and they worked extra with us to make sure my dog was comfortable before I left town!

My two boxers absolutely love going to Yardstick. I never feel guilty going on vacation because I know my dogs are in good hands. I also love that the staff send photos of my dogs throughout their stay.

Very very pleased to have found Yardstick to board my dogs. The facility is really clean and there are a variety of play settings to meet any dog’s needs. What I like most is the individualized care and attention. I truly felt like the staff loved and cared for my dogs as much as I do. Most of all I loved receiving so many photos of my dogs throughout the day. I would highly recommend Yardstick to anyone and will certainly be a repeat customer.

Our dog Olive just completed her stay at Yardstick, and I can only assume the staff there deserve hazard pay, performance bonuses, and possibly a national service medal.

To understand what they were up against, Olive’s feeding routine isn’t really a routine — it’s a full Broadway production complete with dramatic pauses, emotional manipulation, and a guaranteed mid-act intermission. She has a “$eN$iTiVe $tOmAcH,” which is code for “requires a Michelin-star chef to prepare a meal involving boiled chicken at the perfect scientifically validated temperature and consistency.”

She doesn’t eat. She dines.
She doesn’t ask for things. She negotiates with weaponized cuteness.
And halfway through breakfast, she must go poop. This is not optional. This is her circadian law — as reliable as the sunrise and the Swiss train system.

Despite all of this, Yardstick handled her like absolute pros. They kept her happy, healthy, and (somehow) convinced her she wasn’t withering away between meals. Olive came home tired, clean, and smug — which means she had a great time and possibly made some poor staff member her new emotional support human.

We can’t thank the Yardstick team enough for treating our strange, dramatic little gremlin like family. We’re beyond impressed — and deeply grateful that they survived the Olive Experience™ with their sanity (and sense of humor) intact.

My dog tends to get anxious in new places. Right away when you first walk in yardstick, you can tell they’re not like your typical boarding facility. The staff is very friendly and upbeat and clear dog lovers. This was my first time taking my dog to them and they treated her like a princess. She was very calm when I came to pick her up and she’s never that chill. I was gone for four days and she seems happy and they updated me the entire time. I will definitely bring her back for some play date and our next boarding adventure. I don’t trust people with my dog, but I would rather choose them over Rover. 10 out of 10!

We just moved to Dallas and I needed a place to board our dog.  Sunny had the best time there.  I received pictures daily of our dog playing and receiving great care.  She had a great time and was treated so well.  We will be using Yardstick again for all of our dog boarding needs.  thank you.
We only take our dog here when we board him. They will constantly  send pics and vids for updates. It’s the best and our pup Oliver loves it!
Great new place to leave a pet for the day or the weekend.

I left my Dalmatian while on an overnight trip and the team at Lakewood took excellent care of her. They kept me up to date with her stay  thru pictures and videos and gave a her a lot of personal attention during her stay.
The staff and facilities are awesome

Our dog loved her experience at Yardstick Lakewood! She's been hesitant at other boarding facilities in the past, but every picture Yardstick shared (and there were many each day) showed that she was enjoying her stay and being well cared for.

Our small rescue pup was so scared of other daycares. The more personalized attention and the amazing staff at Yardstick have really helped her gain confidence. She loves coming to daycare now and is so excited to see the staff and her pup friends. The photos I get during the day really help solidify my confidence in the care she’s getting. As a delightful bonus, she doesn’t come home smelling terrible like she did with other daycares. Daycare is expensive, but it’s worth it for the extra attention and playgroup sizes.

We’ve boarded our dogs here and dropped them off for daycare. The dogs are always so happy and healthy, the facility is clean, and the staff are friendly and so clearly love dogs. They also send a zillion photos of the dogs having fun throughout the day!

Our rescue Yorkie, Nelly, stayed at Yardstick while we were out of town and had the most fantastic experience! She tends to be a nervous girl, and the team was so kind and accommodating to make sure she was happy and having a blast! We loved seeing her big smile in all of the photos they shared! We will absolutely bring Nelly back to stay again- this was a top notch experience!
Great communication, they provide updates throughout the day, the building is clean and our dog loves it!

Our dogs have never been happier being boarded while we were out of town. Really nice facility. Friendly staff. Our dogs got to stay in a room together with no crate and they were relaxed and happy when I picked them up. We go pics everyday and could tell that they were well cared for.

Gypsy & Georgia spent just one night at Yardstick but we will happily board them longer next time we need to.  I asked for an impromptu tour when I picked up my girls and Leah was happy to show me around! The space is very clean and they take great care of all the pups.  I also loved all the texts and photos while we were gone! Thanks!
They do a fab job and are so attentive. You can tell everyone there loves what they do! The space is clean and quiet, and Mac comes home happy and healthy and tired!
Pricey but staff is amazing and so is the facility.  Love the nap time in private rooms bs kennels
This was our first experience with Yardstick, and it exceeded our expectations. We loved the updates and pictures, seeing our Pittie make new friends. The staff is wonderful as well.

We had such a great experience with Yardstick! Our dog Kobe had a great time, and they updated us frequently with texts with photos of him playing with the other dogs and in his room, eating the treats we ordered for him, etc. We loved getting the updates right in our texts and felt very comfortable with boarding Kobe there. We will definitely be taking him back to Yardstick the next time we need to board him! Highly recommend!

Our first time at Yardstick in Lakewood… and OMG!!
One of the best facilities out there!!
Our dog had SO MUCH FUN!!! He came back home happy and stress free!!
We boarded for 5 nights and ordered room service each night for our little guy… the care team were all incredible and we loved getting our daily pupdate photos!!! Will def be our place for boarding from now on!

I would highly recommend Yardstick for boarding or daycare of your dog.

They are very good with our dog and send regular updates of our dogs stay.
Thank you Michelle! We adore sweet Daisy and are grateful to have her in our Yardstick family. See you both soon!

Scout had a great stay at Yardsticks. She came home happy and healthy! The dogs in her group looked perfect for her size. We really appreciated the pictures and communication we received about how she was doing. She will be staying here again!

We love Yardstick Lakewood! We've used them for daycare, boarding, and baths for our dog, Mack, and every experience has been wonderful. Mack gets so excited when we drop him off!

The facility is super clean, smells great, and the staff give the dogs so much love and attention. We love the photo updates during the day, and being able to bring Mack’s toys and treats for boarding is such a nice touch.

Highly recommend—Yardstick truly feels like a second home for our pup!

We truly can’t say enough wonderful things about Yardstick. Thor and Loki have not had great boarding experiences in the past, so I was really, really anxious about leaving them—but the Yardstick team eased every worry I had and completely changed how we feel about boarding.

From the moment we dropped them off, we could tell this place was different. The team is so kind, thoughtful, and incredibly detail-oriented. They took the time to understand both of our boys - their quirks, their personalities, and what makes them feel safe and happy. They were also super understanding and patient of my crazy dog mom requests, LOL!

What really touched us is how much love they show Thor and Loki. It’s genuine, and it shows. The updates, pictures, and videos they sent (without us having to remind them!) made our day every time and reassured us that the pups were happy, relaxed, and in amazing hands.

Yardstick didn’t just take care of them - they treated them like family. And that means everything to us. We’re so, so grateful to have found them! Thank you, Yardstick, for taking care of Thor and Loki like your own!

What a great experience for both my dog and me!  My puppy had his first day ever in daycare.  They matched him with other puppies/dogs of similar size/play style and he had a great time.   I was grateful I could text and ask for pictures any time.  They showed me him in action and I could see how much fun he was having.  I really appreciate there are rest times as well - especially important for a puppy.
My dog loves this place! The people are so nice, facility is clean, and they are so responsive and transparent with pictures throughout the day. Highly recommend

I have used the daycare service and overnight service for my dog. I felt comfortable leaving my dog with the Yardstick team. The team is responsive to booking requests, welcoming when you arrive and had great communication throughout my dog's stay. The facility is clean and new, I hope that this team will maintain these great standards!
Macie loves it here. She is treated well. I couldn’t ask for a better place to leave her. She is treated like the princess she is.

Theodore always enjoys his stay at yardstick! The photo updates throughout the day do everything to ease my anxiety because I know he’s in good hands! He’s a very photogenic puppy and they make sure to catch all his good sides😊 …

Yardstick is amazing! They are super friendly and really care about your dog. I just love that they are very careful with making sure that they separate dogs by size and energy level. They keep me informed throughout the day with cute little pictures. Soon my baby will be boarding with them. I completely trust them! Will continue to go back!!
They were great with my big guy!
Amazing. Our pup has gone to both daycare and 2 nights boarding and we couldn't ask for a better spot. Highly recommend.
My 2 dogs had a great stay at Yardstick!!  The staff was so nice and sent me tons of pictures throughout the week!  I would definitely recommend them again!

My 8 month old lab comes to the Lakewood location for daycare about 2 times a week and she loves it! Also, as an owner, the staff always seem happy to see her and give great updates during the day via pictures, etc. - making me feel comfortable that my dog is safe and having a good time. Whenever I have had any questions, staff quickly answer. Great place for daycare (and boarding) - highly recommend!
Mila had a great time! Thank you for all the pictures.

Yardstick is far and away the best boarding experience we've ever had.  They communicate frequently (pictures of my dog, how he's doing, etc), the facility is clean, the staff is friendly and seems to clearly care about the pets in their care.

Yardstick Lakewood exceeded my expectations. I scheduled a tour online and T happily greeted us when we arrived. She showed us the entire facility. Which was welcoming and clean. I cannot recommend Yardstick enough. A+ times a million. Staff, facility, you name it - all top of the line.

Where do we even begin! We can’t stop raving about Yardstick. From the adorable decorations to the individual suites and multiple indoor + outdoor play areas, this place is the best. Instead of having one giant play room, the dogs are grouped by temperament and play style.

Since we have one puppy and one senior dog, it was important for them to play together with dogs as a bonded pair. Another great thing about Yardstick is that they have staff onsite 24 hours of the day. I no longer have to worry about the pups being “alone” overnight and this makes flight delays a lot less stressful, knowing that we can pick up “after hours”.

Now, my favorite part: Yardstick texts you photos throughout your pup’s stay just as if your dog was texting you. I’m obsessed with this!

Our dog boarding bar is now set so high with Yardstick, it’s so worth the money!!
